_description: C10 The Slalom — LDR·W Seek (toward light) + one forward IR set to Flow-around (repel + circulate, tangential 3.0). The robot curves around each staggered wall instead of being pushed straight back. A plain repulsor fails here because it also repels from the arena boundary (the start is near the bottom edge) and drives the robot into a corner. Verified ~9s.
